english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for furniture, places, or clothing that looks worn-out and ragged.

exampleSentences.english: That old sofa is so shabby that I really don’t want to sit on it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰張舊梳化殘到直情唔想坐。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 zoeng1 gau6 so1 faa3 caan4 dou3 zik6 cing4 m4 soeng2 co5

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, object, or machine that is run-down and no longer in good condition.

exampleSentences.english: That old computer is really worn-out; it crashes as soon as I open a few programs.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部舊電腦真係殘，開幾個程式就死機。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 caan4 hoi1 gei2 go3 cing4 sik1 zau6 sei2 gei1
